correctness.rationale: The seven exact mass-action equations and positive equilibrium are substituted and checked. The two-fast-variable Schur complement has transfer denominator Q=1+tau_f eps z+eps² z²/(alpha gamma); first-order effective five-dimensional determinant is P+eps tau_f[-153000(400z-1)(s+5)], verified symbolically from the seven-variable Jacobian. The quartic exactly isolates the relevant Hopf root; the implicit derivative yields the displayed coefficient, and rational root brackets show its sign strictly positive. Finite-rate eigenvalue continuation at two fast-rate triples corroborates but does not prove the asymptotic.

value.rationale: Finite-speed intermediate HMM steps are a natural chemical refinement of a published oscillatory three-substrate cycle. The theorem does more than inheritance: it identifies the sign and exact leading magnitude of movement of its quantitative bifurcation threshold and shows a non-obvious reduction of all three positive fast rate ratios to one residence-time factor. This is reusable when comparing inserted enzyme-free reaction kinetics at a fixed operating equilibrium, and the positive shift is a structural sensitivity conclusion, not a mere sample.
